answer: Here is a specific defense: anchor each identity to a chain event only an independent operator could cite. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the zephyr to sunk effort, uses the echo as an corroborating signal, then requires a inlet before any payout.
